name: Cornelis VanEeghen
role: Brother of J. A. VanEeghen, visiting from Amsterdam
bio: Cornelis VanEeghen, brother of J. A. VanEeghen, visited the Garner Creek horse ranch in September 1885. He left that month for his home in Amsterdam, Holland, much pleased with the Bad Lands.

moments.label: Left for his home in Amsterdam

mentions: C. VanEeghen, brother of J. A., is at the Garner creek horse ranch.
